meta.text: Which brings us to the exam trap. The statement 'Enable Photon to speed up every job' is false — it is a targeted lever for CPU-bound operators. And do not conflate Photon with Adaptive Query Execution, Delta caching, or autoscaling. Those are separate mechanisms solving separate problems, and the exam will absolutely test whether you can tell them apart. Next, let's see whether Photon is actually cheaper for a given job.
